title: The keyring clipped over the empty page
body: The clipboard is closed around a keyring. One key leaves a clean outline in the dust, while the page beneath the clip has torn away at the holes.
rival_reading: A field crew could move its notes and keys in a hurry when a test site closed; the torn page does not prove a warning was ignored.
gloss: Keys remain where a page was torn from a clipboard.

title: The rain sketch runs into the bottle ring
body: The notebook shows rain crossing a set of crop rows. A water bottle rests on the open page; its dry ring circles the word “downhill,” written once and then erased.
rival_reading: A response worker could note rain and drainage while planning a safe route; the erased word does not establish an agricultural release.
gloss: A weather sketch and a water mark meet at an erased direction.
